system.description:
Veterans of the Wall facing the Red Waste: disciplined and grim.

  • Wall-Forged Dread: your Demoralise option is harsher: on a failed Will save, enemies have Disadvantage on all their attack rolls. Otherwise it works as Demoralise.
  • Siege Discipline: Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment or coordinating a defence.

features.name: Wall-Forged Dread
features.description: Your Demoralise option is harsher: on a failed Will save, enemies have Disadvantage on all their attack rolls. Otherwise it works as Demoralise. When you give Demoralise, apply this in place of the usual failed-save effect.

features.name: Siege Discipline
features.description: Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment or coordinating a defence.

rules.when: fortification, siege assessment, or coordinating soldiers in a defence
